fields.summary_ko.0: Palantir (PLTR) achieved Q3 revenue growth of nearly 2x, exceeding $2B, but U.S. commercial segment TCV declined from $2.1B in the previous quarter to $1.5B, resulting in a 1.65% stock price decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Analysts assess that the 11% decline in TCV growth rate may be a temporary phenomenon from shortened contract terms, with conversion to longer-term contracts viewed as key going forward.
